subject: MAP kickoff: Sponsor intro & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@brightline.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: Sponsor intro & evaluation timeline

Anita / Samir —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP-draft-v1.docx) that lays out the evaluation milestones, owners, and a proposed 8-week close timeline toward a production commitment. High-level asks for this kickoff:

- Confirm your executive sponsor (VP/CTO level) and procurement contact for commercial timelines.
- Approve the goal date for a go/no-go decision (target: 2027-06-06).
- Confirm technical reviewers and a primary point of contact for security evidence.

Draft milestones (short):
1) Week 1 — Executive sponsor intro + kickoff workshop (30–60m)
2) Weeks 2–3 — Technical deep-dive and performance validation (Rishi to run tests)
3) Weeks 4–5 — Security & compliance QA (attachments: Security-Questionnaire-Response.pdf)
4) Week 6 — Pilot readiness / SOW review (Brightline-SOW-outline.xlsx)
5) Week 8 — Executive decision & next steps

Vanessa (cc'd) has agreed to be our executive-level contact for any prioritization/escalation. Rishi (solutions) will lead the technical validation. Marissa (CS) will own onboarding success criteria.

Can you confirm the sponsor title/name and whether the timeline above is feasible for Brightline? If 8 weeks is tight, tell us what range you prefer and we'll align.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx, Security-Questionnaire-Response.pdf

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@brightline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightline.com
Date: 2027-04-11T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Sponsor intro & evaluation timeline

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan and the doc. I'm the VP of Engineering and will act as the primary sponsor from Brightline. Samir (cc'd) will co-own with me and is our Head of Platform. A couple of immediate notes:

- Procurement needs at least a 10-week runway for internal approvals and PO issuance given our quarter and vendor onboarding process. Can you show a 10-week variant?
- Security will want a named Redwood contact for the SOC 2 / encryption questions — please flag who owns that.
- Please include our legal alias (legal@brightline.com) on any SOW/Docusign circulation.

We can do the kickoff workshop next week. I’ll share internal availability — currently leaning to Tue/Wed mornings (PST).

Thanks,
Anita Rao
VP Engineering | Brightline Financial
anita.rao@brightline.com

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@brightline.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightline.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightline.com, legal@brightline.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Sponsor intro & evaluation timeline

Anita —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming your sponsorship — great to have you leading this. I’ve attached a 10-week variant and shifted a couple of milestones to accommodate procurement (see Brightline-SOW-outline.xlsx). Key updates:

- Updated target decision date: 2027-06-20 (10-week).
- Security lead for Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (cc'd) — he'll be your point for SOC2 artifacts and encryption details; SOC2 evidence stub attached (SOC2-evidence-stub.txt).
- Vanessa will provide the executive-level intro note and alignment on outcomes; Marissa will coordinate onboarding success metrics and pilot acceptance criteria.

Vanessa — would you be comfortable introducing yourself to Anita/Samir as Redwood’s executive sponsor and calling out escalation points and the quarterly outcomes we should be measured on? Short paragraph is fine — they'd like to understand what success looks like from leadership perspective.

Proposed kickoff windows (PT): Tue 2027-04-12 09:00–10:00 or Wed 2027-04-13 11:00–12:00. Anita — pick what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline-SOW-outline.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-stub.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@brightline.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, legal@brightline.com, procurement@brightline.com
Date: 2027-04-11T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Executive sponsor intro — Redwood x Brightline MAP

Anita / Samir —

Thanks for the warm coordination. I'm Vanessa Ortiz, Regional VP at Redwood Inference — I'll serve as the executive sponsor for this engagement. Quick notes on leadership intent and escalation:

- Executive intent: Redwood's objective is to ensure Brightline can evaluate our inference platform against measurable outcomes: latency and cost per transaction within your production patterns, integration simplicity for your pipelines, and predictable SLAs for latency and availability.
- Quarterly outcomes we will jointly track (examples):
  • Q1 (Pilot) — Validate end-to-end integration, meet agreed performance baselines (p50/p95) on representative load, and complete a security checklist.
  • Q2 (Initial production) — 90%+ availability on pilot routes, unit cost within agreed tolerance, and success criteria met by product teams.
- Escalation path: Day-to-day issues -> Karthik (AE) / Marissa (CS); Technical block -> Rishi (Solutions); Executive escalation -> Vanessa (VP) -> Redwood CTO (if needed).

Operational items I recommend we set now: a weekly 30-min working sync for the MAP owners, and a single monthly executive checkpoint (30 min) to track progress against the MAP. I’ve created a shared Drive folder for artifacts and a HubSpot link for deal tracking (links below).

I’ll be present for the initial kickoff and the decision review. If timelines shift, escalate to me so we can prioritize engineering cycles. Looking forward to working together.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Regional VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0199

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx (copied to Drive)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BEXAMPLE/MAP-Brightline, https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7834

From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@brightline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@brightline.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightline.com, legal@brightline.com
Date: 2027-04-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor intro — Redwood x Brightline MAP

Vanessa — thank you, that helps a lot. The executive outcomes and escalation path are clear and acceptable. We’ll target the Tue 2027-04-12 09:00 PT kickoff — Samir and I will be there. Procurement will start the paperwork based on the 10-week timeline; legal will expect SOW + Docusign link (please cc legal@brightline.com when routing).

Action items I’ll take:
- Share internal availability and confirm attendees for the kickoff (security, platform, procurement).
- Circulate a short list of required artifacts for SOC2 review (we expect a dedicated contact and a timeline).

Rishi — please share the SOC2 artifact set with our security team and point person; we’ve attached a preliminary security questionnaire to this reply.

Onward — see you in the kickoff.

Best,
Anita Rao
VP Engineering | Brightline Financial

Attachments: Security-Questionnaire-Response.pdf
